job.question: A county pension fund is searching for a single manager of managers covering domestic equity, international equity and fixed income. What is the maximum mandate size, and what is the firm-level AUM limit for responders?
job.expected_facts: A mandate of up to $350 million; responders must have less than $30 billion in firm-level assets under management (Cook County Fund, RFP 25-0004).
job.acceptance: Accept up to $350m and firm AUM strictly below $30bn. Cook County identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund sample RFP for investment consulting services, not the county fund’s single manager-of-managers mandate. It provides neither the mandate maximum nor a firm-level AUM eligibility limit for responders.
quotes: The Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) is requesting proposals from investment consulting firms to provide general investment consulting, real estate consulting and performance measurement services (bundled or unbundled) to its Board of Trustees
Be sure to include in your response: - total assets or client relationships that will be accepted - maximum limits on asset amounts or number of clients per consultant
